title: Exit Notice Shortfall Charge — Lease Term Agreement Accounting Standard
content:
The exit notice shortfall charge on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement is the daily rent, the term's contracted rent times 12 divided by 365 and rounded half up to the cent, times the shortfall days; the charge is rounded half up to the cent.

## Quantities

- **Shortfall days.** The notice an exit requires less the days of notice given, never fewer than zero.
- **Notice an exit requires.** The term program's notice to vacate days, as published in the notice to vacate schedule of the program.
- **Days of notice given.** The calendar days from the date the request was received to the requested termination date — the number of days by which the received date precedes the termination date. The received date is the date the open lease-break request was submitted, and the termination date is the date asked for on it.
- **Daily rent.** The contracted rent of the term multiplied by 12 and divided by 365, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Rounding half up.** An amount reaching half a cent, or falling short of half a cent by no more than 0.0001 cents, is rounded up to the next cent; any other amount is rounded down.

## Worked lines (hypothetical)

| Contracted rent | Program notice | Received | Termination date | Days given | Shortfall | Daily rent | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1,825.00 | 60 days | 1 August | 15 September | 45 | 15 | 60.00 | 900.00 |
| 2,000.00 | 45 days | 1 August | 5 September | 35 | 10 | 65.75 | 657.50 |
| 1,825.00 | 60 days | 1 August | 5 October | 65 | none (never below zero) | 60.00 | none |

For 2,000.00 dollars: 2,000.00 multiplied by 12 is 24,000.00; divided by 365 is 65.7534…, rounded half up to 65.75.
